testcase.name: dangling references are reported with the path of the reference()
ids and names must follow their patterns()
data bindings are checked against the sections and the component props()
collection sizes are limited()
schemaVersion and kind must be known values()
an action cannot carry a URL SQL or code()
unknown fields inside definitions are rejected with a path()
raw URLs are rejected in every text field()
reads are bound to data and never run as writes()
workflow trigger and schedule must agree()
theme and publish draft are bounded and typed()
actions need the references their type requires()
page and section rules still come from PageSchemaValidator()
parameter defaults must be plain scalars of the declared type()
reference cycles are detected()
a V2 document that declares schemaVersion may not carry unknown top-level keys but a legacy one may()
non-object documents do not blow up()
an empty definition set is valid and each optional key may be used on its own()
explicit nulls and wrong json types are rejected()
duplicate ids are reported per collection()
typed validate delegates the same way()
the extension area rejects URLs credentials SQL and code-like keys at any depth()
the sample V2 document is valid()
requireValid throws the same ApiException as PageSchemaValidator()
a mapping must fit the view model that uses it()
